Nº 04 · Decision analysis

GitHub Open-Source Success Analysis

Miuul graduation project · 129 GitHub projects

Scores 129 popular GitHub projects on five criteria (stars, forks, open issues and PRs, star velocity and project age) and ranks them with multi-criteria decision methods. Expert weights (AHP, Fuzzy AHP) and data-driven weights (Entropy, CRITIC) feed TOPSIS and VIKOR, and a sensitivity test checks how stable the ranking is.
